tagline.en: ATI-Wan2.1-14B — ByteDance's trajectory-controlled image-to-video, adding drawn motion paths on top of Wan2.1 14B.
tagline.zh: ATI-Wan2.1-14B——字节跳动的轨迹可控图生视频，在 Wan2.1 14B 之上加入手绘运动路径控制。

en: ATI (from ByteDance Research) is a controllable image-to-video method that lets you steer motion by drawing trajectories: you sketch paths on the input image and the model animates the scene so objects follow them. This build pairs it with the Wan2.1 image-to-video 14B backbone at 480p.

In WorldFoundry only ATI's inference delta is vendored, reusing the shared in-tree Wan2.1 base implementation; at runtime it loads a read-only union of the ATI weights and locally staged Wan2.1 I2V components. It ships as code with weights, and both the ATI and Wan2.1 checkpoints are resolved from local assets.
zh: ATI（来自字节跳动研究院）是一种可控图生视频方法，让你通过绘制轨迹来操控运动：你在输入图像上勾画路径，模型便让场景中的物体沿其运动。本构建将其与 480p 的 Wan2.1 图生视频 14B 主干结合。
在 WorldFoundry 中，仅内置 ATI 的推理增量部分，复用共享的内置 Wan2.1 基础实现；运行时它加载 ATI 权重与本地准备的 Wan2.1 I2V 组件的只读并集。它以代码加权重形式发布，ATI 与 Wan2.1 的 checkpoint 均从本地资源解析。

whenToUse.en: Use ATI-Wan2.1-14B when you want fine-grained motion control in image-to-video by drawing trajectories, backed by the higher-fidelity Wan2.1 14B model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在图生视频中通过绘制轨迹实现精细运动控制，并以更高保真度的 Wan2.1 14B 为后盾时，选择 ATI-Wan2.1-14B。

notFor.en: Runs on the 14B backbone and requires both ATI and Wan2.1 I2V checkpoints staged locally — plan for the download and hardware.
notFor.zh: 运行于 14B 主干，需在本地同时准备 ATI 与 Wan2.1 I2V 的 checkpoint——请预留下载与硬件资源。
